title.rendered: A New Way to Sort Single Stream

content.rendered:
Republic Services, Plano, TX uses positive sorting to get higher quality paper. Paper is sorted out optically to get a cleaner fraction. A first-class education center and safety features such as single-level QC sorting helped this plant win NWRA’s 2019 Recycling Facility of the Year award.

Read about Positive Sorting, a revolutionary concept that redefines the MRF system.
